experiment_name: 7-day Binance demo crypto Spot paper trading experiment
note: Crypto trades around the clock: six checks a day, every four hours in Asia/Kuala_Lumpur time, on seven consecutive calendar days. Stops and targets rest on the demo exchange between checks.

tasks.label: Four-hourly check 00:00
instructions: Read AGENTS.md, strategy, schedule, continuity, readiness, current-state, and latest journal.
Let the engine reconcile any stop or target the demo exchange triggered since the last check.
Manage an open position: hold, or close when the thesis is invalid; positions are closed after 24 hours.
With no position, a new entry is allowed only with at least two independent evidence categories.
Record the decision, evidence, holdings, cash, risk and next focus. Demo account only.
